new_results.statement: For B=[[N,u],[v^T,b]], b!=0, S=N-b^{-1}uv^T and D_pq the squared aggregate of bordered 3x3 minors using the appended row/column, D_pq=b^2 E2(S) exactly. Thus E3(B)<2^-18 implies |b|sqrt(E2(S))<2^-9.

There are full-target bipartite matrices with four eigenvalues of modulus >=1, arbitrarily strict local scalar/pair/triple no-pivot geometry, delta=F=1 and |b|sqrt(E2(N))=1, while E2(N-b^{-1}uv^T)=D_pq=E3(B)=E5(B)=0 exactly. Hence raw-E2 survival or positive bordered-volume forcing is false.

For disjoint original-coordinate banks and Q=2 X_I^T M X_J with rank(M)=2 and singular values sigma1>=sigma2>0, ||p_Q||inf<=2sqrt(pi)(sigma1 sigma2)^(-1/2). Independent disjoint addends preserve the bound by convolution.
